notes.title: New Year update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. Just a little follow up from the last update.

[list]
[*] Heroes will now have trophies next to them after beating bosses.
[*] Orc and Undead perks now stack correctly (before this patch secondary bonuses were not applied correctly).
[*] Difficulty levels will now have perks and penalties applied correctly
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Patch
notes.notes:
Hi guys. Just a minor patch rollout that mainly tries to address issues some players have with unlocking content.

How it worked previously: Pretty much everything was based on Steam achievements. If you did a campaign mission that unlocks a hero, you'd get an achievement, and that achievement was checked for when seeing if your content is unlocked.

This currently doesn't work for some users (not just pirates! :) ) so we're now adding a backup. We'll also be storing achievement data in your save file, which should be pretty much full proof (famous last words). 

Lastly we added order colours to the formation when you load it in!

notes.title: Tactics update!
notes.notes:
Hi guys! We've been reading your reviews, discussions and e-mails since the game's release and took a lot of feedback on board. TACTICS update brings it all together with some new QoL features, as well as something that changes the game completely. Priority orders.

[h1]Tactics[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623867/29326c8c6aa88de7e88433c935bdfd375b3b7f5f.png[/img]

Before the battle begins, you're now able to select a tactic your units use. You can target the closest unit, Ranged Troops, Cavalry or Infantry. Your units will ignore other unit types as long as selected tactic is in effect (until the chosen enemy type is dead).

This means your cavalry can now actually flank and dash for ranged troops, rather than going for the closest enemy every time.

We've also updated how AI works - troops no longer select a target at the beginning and stick to them no matter what - instead they'll re-evaluate the target during the battle, always going for the closest enemy (if that's the chosen tactic).

For now, the AI does not use any other strategy than closest enemy - we're still thinking whether to change that and would love your input on this.

[h1]Saved Formations[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623867/96d839f6ae7a2f643ac1ff436e78957fc19c7897.png[/img]

In Adventure mode you'll find a new button - it will load the troop placement from the previous battle. We found it to be quite useful, especially with specific builds.

[h1]Range information[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623867/c8d74c5cd22cb63265ddc936044b244fc80c0228.png[/img]

Another QoL that you've requested is ranged information. You're now able to view the range of attack of individual units - both yours and the enemy. 

Lastly... we know that some players have had issues with Steam Achievements. A lot of the progress is saved through them (for example unlocking other races by defeating the enemy bosses). We know that the game always works on the second run, but for some it won't do on the first run. Just in case we did add something that should track most important achievements regardless of Steam status, and award them on next run.

Please let us know what you think of these changes. We drive the development of the game with your feedback, so it's super important for us. Also please considering reviewing the game if you haven't done so already! It REALLY helps us! We hope to get back to Very Positive, rather than Mixed :)
